desc:
☢️🥚 Welcome to Nuke For Eggs!

💥 Use powerful nukes to destroy walls and reach rare eggs!
🥷 Steal eggs from animals — but watch out for their guardians!
🐣 Bring eggs back to your base and hatch amazing pets!
💰 Earn Cash from your pets and upgrade your base!
⬆️ Upgrade your nuke power and unlock stronger nukes!
🥚 Steal eggs from other players!
✨ Discover rarer eggs, pets, sizes, and mutations!
Don’t forget to leave a thumbs up! 👍

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet!
